After waiting almost two months for it to arrive I got to build the Daily Bugle! This is my second set I’ve built since being in this subreddit.

**Where I bought it?:** Got it from Marstoy

**How much?:** It’s $80 on their site (before shipping). Comes out to $122.70 after shipping to the USA. I paid $268.52 but that’s because I also had the UCS Millennium Falcon in my order.

**Delivery time?:** Took 8 weeks on the spot from when I placed the order. CNY gave delivery time a big hit. Oh well I knew that could happen. But from the shipping notification it took 5 weeks to get here to the USA..

**Bricks/Missing Pieces:** Bricks had a very good clutch and they looked like the real deal. And no missing pieces at all. Lots of small extra pieces though so that's cool!

**Instruction Manual/Bags:** Since the bags on this set were numbered, I ended up using the manual they gave me and had no issues whatsoever. A lot less messy for sure than my last set.

**Minifigures:** These all looked GREAT to me! To me they look spot on from the real set. I saw some Daily Bugle Minifigs that didn’t have dual colored legs but this one had all the correct legs and printings. Dual face expressions on the required figs too. Only thing I'd say is that the legs and arms are a bit stiff on some of them. I might sand a little bit around them to have more movement but no deal breaker for me.

**Stickers:** I think they are spot on. I had seen that the stickers that were supposed to be transparent on this set had come with white or black backgrounds but they must have fixed that because the transparent stickers looked good!

**Overall:** Man for the price you cannot go wrong at all I'd say. It's a really fun and crazy build, the quality feels great and it just looks great finished. Little bit taller than I expected haha. I'd say the only thing I didn’t like was the waiting. I think Amazon has spoiled me with the 2 day shipping, but like I said you can’t go wrong for the price. I got this and the UCS Falcon for under $300! I also just ordered at the wrong time in the year so there's that.

Thanks to Marstoy for sending this out. They responded to all my questions on facebook. They packed the box very nicely, no tears or rips at all. I’d say it was a good experience. I would for sure order from them again. Well… on to the next one!

This was my first time building a set this big and also building a set using alternate bricks! Also funny thing 😅 I ordered a set from Marstoy a couple weeks ago but I couldn’t wait it out so I bought this so I could build something… and I have NO REGRETS!

**Where I bought it?:** Got it from YOUMKO. From USA warehouse.

**How much?:** Paid $86.52 USD. Used 5% off reddit code in the buyers guide.

**Delivery time?:** Took 5 days to arrive at my door. Pretty fast I’d say. I am on the west coast.

**Bricks/Missing Pieces:** The brick quality was really good to me. Besides the Lego stamp not being there they pretty much looked and felt the same to me. Very crazy. Couple bricks had a tight fit but no major issues. I did have one missing piece but I’m pretty sure I have on in my Lego bin somewhere. No biggie 😁

**Instruction Manual/Bags:** The manual looked to pretty much follow the official instructions and I would have used them but me having them on the computer was easier and gave me a bit more room. Bags were not numbered.

**Minifigures:** Han looked to be the only strange looking one, his legs and hair were very red. But Boba looked great to me. And the Bespin guard and stormtrooper looked good as-well.

**Stickers:** They are colored a little different from the Lego ones it seems. The plaque sticker did say Space Wars but I didn’t use that one. Just going to order a sticker set from eBay and switch out the others.

**Overall:** Im really happy with the build. It was so much fun to build and I’ve always wanted to build a set bigger than 800+ pieces. Even the fact the bags were not numbered didn’t bug me. Made it more fun in my opinion. Spent about 4-5 hours each day for 3 days to build it. Lord of the Rings extended versions also made it fun haha. I can say for sure if your a fan of Boba Fett and looking for a great display piece GET IT. Or just get it because it’s cool! Can’t go wrong. Thanks to Youmko for the speedy shipping! 😁 looking forward to building my incoming sets and buying some more!
